track: Track 02: The Agent That Can Explain Why

sponsor_technologies.Zetaris: activesite/adapters/zetaris.py (REST adapter: bearer, org id, request id per call) and activesite/adapters/zetaris_mcp.py (MCP tools list_sources, read-only query); catalog-STANDIN (DuckDB) in activesite/adapters/catalog_standin.py until credentials are set
sponsor_technologies.Meterless H-MEM: activesite/memory/hmem.py implements MemoryStoreService (SQLite store, provenance, append-only ledger) and MemoryRetrievalService (keyword/tag/layer/recency scoring); NOT implemented: semantic, domain and entity scoring terms, remote Meterless endpoint (METERLESS_ENDPOINT is read but unused)
sponsor_technologies.NVIDIA: activesite/llm.py ModelClient against integrate.api.nvidia.com (OpenAI-compatible chat completions); used only when MODEL_API_KEY is set, output allow-listed by the Planner

models.llm: nvidia/llama-3.3-nemotron-super-49b-v1 via MODEL_BASE_URL (optional; runs without it in fallback mode)
models.chemistry: PM6 semi-empirical QM/MM single points in AmberTools 26 sander (activesite-engine:at26); GAFF2 + AM1-BCC ligand parameters; ff14SB protein; PDB2PQR + PROPKA 3.5.1 protonation

entry_points.http: POST /run {"case_id": ...} returns the same JSON as run.py --json; POST /api/run + GET /run/stream for the live UI

sample_mode.behaviour: replays data/sample/<case>/ engine outputs and prep artefacts through the real parser and all agents; results are labelled 'cached engine output (sample mode)'; a missing cache is reported as 'engine unavailable', never synthesised
sample_mode.generated_by: scripts/make_samples.sh on a Docker host (see data/sample/MANIFEST.md)
